answer: Trust is lent, never claimed. Each epoch the node broadcasts beacons, fresh random numbers, and an attestation counts only if it folds one into a mirror of the account's last answer then signs. The beacons move peer to peer, so a new account hears nothing until a peer introduces it. Each peer introduces two names per epoch, staking 300 POA each; the bond burns if the vouchee grades as spam in three epochs. A farm lighting fifty clones needs thirteen peers vouching, risking 15,000 POA. The door keeps a velvet rope; whoever waved a guest past pays when that guest turns out plastic.
